-- Check High-Frequency High-Risk Traders
-- High-Risk: (TLE > 5.0 AND risklevel = 'Aggressive') OR DTR > 0.5
-- High-Frequency High-Risk: High-Risk AND freqscope = 'High'
SELECT t.tradereg, 
       t.freqscope,
       t.acctbal,
       t.voldaily,
       (t.trading_performance->'risklevel'->>'levratio')::numeric as levratio,
       t.trading_performance->'risklevel'->>'risklevel' as rl_risklevel,
       CASE WHEN t.acctbal > 0 THEN t.voldaily / t.acctbal ELSE NULL END as dtr
FROM trader t
WHERE t.freqscope = 'High'
AND (
    ((t.trading_performance->'risklevel'->>'levratio')::numeric > 5.0 
     AND t.trading_performance->'risklevel'->>'risklevel' = 'Aggressive')
    OR 
    (CASE WHEN t.acctbal > 0 THEN t.voldaily / t.acctbal ELSE NULL END) > 0.5
)
LIMIT 10;

-- Full query for Costly High-Frequency Risk Enforcement cases
WITH high_freq_high_risk_traders AS (
    SELECT t.tradereg
    FROM trader t
    WHERE t.freqscope = 'High'
    AND (
        ((t.trading_performance->'risklevel'->>'levratio')::numeric > 5.0 
         AND t.trading_performance->'risklevel'->>'risklevel' = 'Aggressive')
        OR 
        (CASE WHEN t.acctbal > 0 THEN t.voldaily / t.acctbal ELSE NULL END) > 0.5
    )
),
financially_impactful AS (
    SELECT ea.enforcereg, ea.resstat, ea.penamt, trd.acctbal,
           ea.penamt / NULLIF(trd.acctbal, 0) as efir
    FROM enforcementactions ea
    JOIN compliancecase cc ON ea.compref2 = cc.compreg
    JOIN transactionrecord tr ON cc.transref = tr.transreg
    JOIN trader trd ON tr.trdref = trd.tradereg
    WHERE (ea.penimp IN ('Fine', 'Ban') OR ea.acttake = 'Suspension' OR ea.busrestr = 'Full')
)
SELECT fi.enforcereg, fi.resstat
FROM financially_impactful fi
JOIN high_freq_high_risk_traders hfhr ON fi.enforcereg IS NOT NULL  -- need to link via trader
WHERE fi.efir > 0.1;
